'''Stephen Cellucci''' is an inactive member of [[Team 5]]<ref name="slack-2021">Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, Joe Olson (arebelspy), 14 January 2021</ref>. He played the [[2024 Eclipse Major]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2024-04-eclipse-major-indianapolis-indiana-apr-5-7/ 2024 Eclipse Major], starwarsccg.org</ref>
